lessonTitle: 58. The equation of a surface in space
lessonTitleEnglish: The equation of a surface in space
unit: Geometry · Chapter III. Coordinates in space
source: Based on the topics of the Armenian grade 11 mathematics textbooks (general stream)

stages.headline: The equation of a surface is an equation F(x; y; z) = 0 satisfied by the coordinates of its points and only by them.
stages.headlineEnglish: The equation of a surface is an equation F(x; y; z) = 0 satisfied by the coordinates of its points and only by them.

stages.headline: The sphere with centre C(a; b; c) and radius R: (x − a)² + (y − b)² + (z − c)² = R².
stages.headlineEnglish: The sphere with centre C(a; b; c) and radius R: (x − a)² + (y − b)² + (z − c)² = R².

stages.headline: Example: (x − 1)² + y² + (z + 2)² = 9 has centre (1; 0; −2) and radius 3.
stages.headlineEnglish: Example: (x − 1)² + y² + (z + 2)² = 9 has centre (1; 0; −2) and radius 3.
